[[Central Español]] |prevseason = [[2011–12 Uruguayan Primera División season|2011–12]] |nextseason = [[2013–14 Uruguayan Primera División season|2013–14]] }} The '''2012–13 [[Primera División Uruguaya|Liga Profesional de Primera División]] season''', also known as the '''2012–13 Copa Uruguaya''' or the '''2012–13 Campeonato Uruguayo''', was the 109th season of [[Uruguay]]'s top-flight football league, and the 82nd in which it was professional. [[Club Nacional de Football|Nacional]] was the defending champion. ==Teams== Sixteen teams will compete in the Primera División this season. Thirteen teams remained from the 2011–12 season. [[Club Atlético Rentistas|Rentistas]], [[Rampla Juniors]], and [[Club Sportivo Cerrito|Cerrito]] were relegated after accumulating the fewest points in the relegation table. They were replaced by [[Central Español]], [[Juventud de Las Piedras|Juventud]], and [[Club Atlético Progreso|Progreso]], the 2011–12 Segunda División winner, runner-up, and playoff winner, respectively.
